intro: The indefinido of -er and -ir verbs, and the words that tell when something happened.
p.comí.consejo: Verbs in -er take -í in «yo»: comí, bebí, aprendí.
p.comiste.consejo: With «tú» it always ends in -iste: comiste, viviste, escribiste.
p.comió.consejo: The accent marks the final stress: «ko-MYO». Without it, it would be the present «come».
p.viví.consejo: Verbs in -ir also take -í in «yo»: viví, escribí, salí.
p.salimos.consejo: In -ir verbs, «nosotros» is the same in present and past; context decides.
p.volvieron.consejo: In the past «volver» keeps its o: «volví», not «vuelví».
p.escribí.consejo: The accent in «escribí» sits on the last syllable; without it the person changes.
p.anoche.consejo: «Anoche» already means «yesterday night»; you do not say «ayer anoche».
p.anteayer.consejo: You can also say «antes de ayer»; both forms are correct.
p.la semana pasada.consejo: «Pasada» agrees with the noun: «la semana pasada», «el año pasado».
p.el año pasado.consejo: The ñ sounds like «ny»: «A-nyo». With this phrase use the indefinido.
p.hace dos días.consejo: «Hace» goes before the time and means «ago»: «hace tres meses».
b1.texto:
Regular verbs in **-er** and **-ir** share the same endings in the indefinido: **-í, -iste, -ió, -imos, -isteis, -ieron**.

- **comer**: comí, comiste, comió, comimos, comisteis, comieron
- **vivir**: viví, viviste, vivió, vivimos, vivisteis, vivieron

It is used for finished events, with words like **ayer, anoche, anteayer, la semana pasada, el año pasado, hace dos días**.

Careful: **nosotros** in **-ir** verbs is the same in the present and the past: **vivimos**. The time word tells you which one it is.
b2.f0.texto: What did you eat last night?
b2.f1.texto: I ate fish at Ana's house.
b2.f3.texto: When did you get back home?
b2.f4.texto: We left at ten and got back at twelve.
b2.f5.texto: I wrote to my sister the day before yesterday.
b2.f6.texto: I lived in Lima last year.
b2.f7.texto: My cousins came back from Lima two days ago.
b4.texto:
Drop **-er** or **-ir** and add the ending:

- **yo**: -í (comí, viví)
- **tú**: -iste (comiste, viviste)
- **él, ella, usted**: -ió (comió, vivió)
- **nosotros**: -imos (comimos, vivimos)
- **vosotros**: -isteis (comisteis, vivisteis)
- **ellos, ellas, ustedes**: -ieron (comieron, vivieron)

Some changes: **volver → volví** (the o does not change), **buscar → busqué**, **llegar → llegué** (the u keeps the sound of g).

With **hace** + time you say how long ago: **hace dos días**. With **pasado** you talk about the previous period: **la semana pasada**.
b4.e1.texto: My friends lived there two years ago.
b4.e2.texto: Last week I wrote an email.
b5.f0.texto: Last night I went to the harbour with my grandfather.
b5.f1.texto: The salty wind moved the white sails of the boats.
b5.f2.texto: The yellow lights trembled on the dark water.
b5.f3.texto: My grandfather ate warm bread beside the pier.
b5.f4.texto: I drank hot milk and felt the cold on my face.
b5.f5.texto: Afterwards we went back slowly through narrow streets.
b5.f6.texto: A grey cat ran behind a poster.
b5.f7.texto: A smell of fresh bread came out of an open window.
b5.f8.texto: My grandfather lived many years in that city of light and salt.
b5.f9.texto: That night I wrote a whole page about the sea.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! -er verbs take -í in «yo» in the past.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Como» is the present. Last night is already over.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Comeré» is the future, and last night is over.
b6.pregunta: You talk about last night. Which form of «comer» do you use?
b7.o1.refuerzo: You hear it often, but the correct ending has no final -s: -iste.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That is another past, for habits. Here it is a single night.
b8.traduccion: We ate at a Peruvian restaurant
b9.pregunta: You want to say «two days ago». What do you say?
b10.frase: Ella ____ una carta a su hermana.
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Escribe» is the present. The sentence is about something already done.
b10.o1.refuerzo: That word does not exist: the ending is -ió, with i and o together.
b10.o2.refuerzo: Yes! With «ella» the ending is -ió, with an accent.
b11.pregunta: Write the «yo» form of «vivir» in the past.
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Mañana» is about the future: it would be a plan.
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Siempre» is about habit and takes the present.
b12.o2.refuerzo: That's it! «Anoche» is over, so «salimos» is past.
b12.pregunta: With «salimos», which word confirms it is past?
p.volvisteis.consejo: It is the «vosotros» past, used mainly in Spain. In America people say «ustedes volvieron».
p.volvimos.consejo: In -ir verbs, «nosotros» is the same in present and past; with «volver» (-er) the form is the same too: «volvimos».
p.vivieron.consejo: Past of «ellos» in -ir verbs: -ieron. The v sounds b and «ie» is one syllable: BYE.
p.correo.consejo: «Un correo» is short for «correo electrónico». Both «e» and «o» are strong vowels, so they are two syllables: ko-RRE-o.
p.puerto.consejo: «Ue» is one syllable: PWER-to. It is masculine: «el puerto».
p.abuelo.consejo: The grandmother is «abuela». «Los abuelos» usually means both grandparents.
p.movió.consejo: It comes from «mover». The v sounds b. The accent marks the final stress: mo-BYO.
p.barcos.consejo: Plural of «barco». The c before o sounds k.
p.temblaron.consejo: Past of «ellos» in -ar verbs: -aron. In the present «temblar» changes (tiembla), but not in the past.
p.muelle.consejo: «Ue» is one syllable and the ll sounds y: MWE-ye. It is masculine: «el muelle».
p.bebí.consejo: Past of «yo» in -er verbs: -í with an accent. Without it, «bebi» does not exist.
p.sentí.consejo: It also means «I heard» in some contexts. «Sentir» changes e to ie in the present (siento), but not in «yo» past.
p.gata.consejo: The male is «gato». Many people use «gato» for both; «gata» stresses that it is female.
p.corrió.consejo: The rr is strong and «io» is one syllable: ko-RRYO. The accent marks the end of the past.
p.salió.consejo: «Salir» is regular in the past: «salió». In the future it adds d: «saldrá».
p.vivió.consejo: Past of «él» in -ir verbs: -ió. Both v letters sound b: bi-BYO.
p.entera.consejo: It agrees with «página»: feminine, «una página entera». The masculine is «entero».
p.volviste.consejo: For «tú» the past in -er verbs ends in -iste, with no accent: «volviste», «comiste».
p.comimos.consejo: Past of «nosotros» in -er verbs: -imos. The c before o sounds k.
p.peruano.consejo: Nationality adjectives are not capitalised in Spanish: «un restaurante peruano». Feminine: «peruana».
p.escribió.consejo: The past of «él» in -ir verbs is -ió. The participle «escrito» is irregular, but the past is regular.
